messages:
Dana: kicking off a HALF cutover to router-v2 in us-east1 now, will ramp to 50% in staged steps. keeping window til 02:00z.
deploy-bot: deploy started for service=router target=router-v2 region=us-east1 strategy=half-cutover user=Dana
Priya: copying checklist from canary run — watch p95 latency, 5xx rate, and request success ratio for top 10 routes. set alert if p95 +25% or 5xx > 0.5% over 5m.
Jason: will run synthetic probe every 30s against /health and /api/ping across 3 zones. posting probe command: `for z in a b c; do curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" http://router.$z.us-east1.internal/health; done`
Luca: reminder: session affinity toggle is different between v1 and v2. we're keeping affinity window at 15m to avoid session drops.
Amanda: - If errors spike, immediate action = pause at current weight and revert to previous route group.
Priya: suggested hold points: 5% -> verify 2m -> 20% -> verify 10m -> 50% -> final. we'll pause automatically on alert.
infra-bot: traffic-split update applied: us-east1 weight router-v2=5% router-v1=95% (initiated by Dana)
Jason: initial probes look clean. p95=110ms, 5xx=0.02%. no regressions on top 10 routes.
Dana: moving to 20% now. leaving a 10m observation window. tagging eng-oncall to standby. @eng-oncall please ack.
Luca: acked. monitoring KV cache hit rates — small dip expected, watching for >10% drop.
deploy-bot: traffic-split update applied: us-east1 weight router-v2=20% router-v1=80% (initiated by Dana)
Priya: running scripted smoke: `make smoke-routers ENV=staging TARGET=us-east1 --quick` results -> all green except one 500 on /session/renew from edge-c-2, investigating.
Jason: digging into edge-c-2 logs: saw a transient auth timeout to tok-service at 14:03:22. retry rate bumped. looks like a downstream glitch, not router code.
Amanda: decision: keep rolling, but hold at 20% until next check if auth retries persist.
Dana: agreed. will not progress to 50% until we see stable 10m window. updating release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-router-v2
Luca: also note we pinned model-routing config to v1.2 to avoid unexpected hashing changes. config pin: `model-routing: v1.2`
Priya: if we need to rollback quickly, use: `infractl traffic split set --region us-east1 --v2 0` then `infractl rollback service router --to-tag v1` — keep that handy.
infra-bot: scheduled rollback job dry-run available: /ops/jobs/rollback-dryrun/6312345679
Jason: next checkpoint in ~7m. current metrics: p95=115ms (+4%), 5xx=0.03%. KV cache hit = 92% (baseline 95%). within tolerances.
Dana: small note: Ops asked to keep node-provision slack channel open in case we need to spin extra capacity.
Amanda: can we enable quick-evac guard? set `evac-threshold=1.2` so we can nudge traffic automatically if p95 > 1.2x baseline.
Priya: added temporary alert `router-v2-p95-deviation` with 1.2x threshold and 3m window.
deploy-bot: pause job scheduled at 6312345960 if no manual continue.
Jason: probe results still fine, going to promote to 50% in 2m if no anomalies.
Luca: also verifying stickiness compatibility for websocket routes separately — those need manual approval.
Dana: proceed to 50% now. leave rollback command at hand.
deploy-bot: traffic-split update applied: us-east1 weight router-v2=50% router-v1=50% (initiated by Dana)
Jason: after ramp p95=160ms (+41%). 5xx=0.4% (spike). opening quick log tail.
Priya: spike seems concentrated on /generate and correlates with longer seq lengths in requests — could be model-serving upstream overload.
Amanda: pause and hold. set weight back to 20% immediately.
deploy-bot: traffic-split update applied: us-east1 weight router-v2=20% router-v1=80% (initiated by Amanda)
Dana: rolling back further? we need to decide: full rollback to v1 or keep v2 at 20% while we triage.
Jason: recommend keep at 20% and throttle generation endpoints at an app level until model-serving team confirms capacity.
Luca: agree. create temporary rate-limit on /generate for v2: `nginx limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=gen:10m rate=20r/s`
Priya: logging incident in PagerDuty as P2; tagging model-serving and infra teams.
Amanda: updating release notes with incident and actions.
Dana: ok — status: HOLD at 20%. triage continues. will re-evaluate in 30m and either resume ramp or rollback fully.
Jason: copying relevant logs to /ops/incident/6312345679/logs.tar.gz and posting to the incident thread.
deploy-bot: deploy finished stage: paused at 20% (user action: Amanda)
Luca: thanks all. small reminder: update runbook with the threshold numbers we used so next run isn't guesswork.
Priya: +1 on runbook update. assigning to Dana.
Dana: will update runbook and follow up with a postmortem if we end up rolling back. marking this thread closed for now, will reopen with updates. :white_check_mark:
